property.template_desc: A question whose answer is saved as a custom detail.

info.editor_fields: Drag questions from the list on the left into the form. Use the gear to adjust the label, the width and whether an answer is required. Drag questions to change their order.
info.editor_conditions: A question can appear only under a condition. Open its settings and switch on "Only show if …". Then choose an earlier question and the answer that should make it appear – for example "age under 20" or "I have rowed before is checked".
info.editor_several: You combine several conditions with "all met" (every one must apply) or "at least one met".
info.editor_blocks: If a whole section should appear or disappear, put the condition on the divider in front of it. It applies to all questions up to the next divider.
info.editor_hidden: Whatever is hidden does not count: it does not have to be filled in and it is not saved.
info.editor_order: A condition can only refer to a question further up. If you move questions so that this is no longer true, the form shows you a note.
info.editor_derived: Under "Calculated values" you define what the form works out from the answers by itself – for example the type of registration from age and rowing experience. The person does not see this question.
info.editor_properties: Questions that only exist in your club are saved as a "custom detail". They appear in the application under the further details, with the question as the label. Yes/no, numbers and text are possible.
info.editor_preview: In the preview you try out the form just like the person who will fill it in later.
info.filler_required: Fields with a star must be filled in. As long as something is missing, you cannot submit the form.
info.filler_conditions: Some questions only appear once you have answered something particular further up. If you change an answer, questions can disappear again – whatever you entered there is then not saved.
info.filler_privacy: Your details go only to the people who look after this form.
info.editor_implicit: A "hidden field" is not seen by the person. You set its value on the page that shows the form – for example which course the registration is for. That way one form is enough for many courses.
info.editor_prefill: In the preview you can enter answers and create a link from them. Whoever opens it finds these answers already filled in – handy for one link per course.
info.editor_other: For multiple-choice questions you can allow "Other …". The person can then write their own answer.
info.editor_after: Under "After submitting" you write the thanks the person sees – if you like different depending on the answer, and also by e-mail.
info.editor_limit: Under "Accepting responses" you close the form by hand, on a date or after a number of responses. If several pages show the same form, each page can have its own number of places.
info.filler_prefilled: Some answers are already filled in because you came through a personal link. You cannot change locked fields.
info.filler_limit: This form accepts only a certain number of responses or closes on a date. Better to respond sooner than later.
info.filler_mail: You will receive a confirmation at the e-mail address you enter.
